EFW_Theo.name: Theo
EFW_Theo.role: Junior attaché / cartographic thinker drawn into the reawakening war
EFW_Theo.notes: Source-locked traits: obsessive geometric cognition; persistent visions of ancient architecture; thumb-to-index-finger motion that maps the phantom weight of a tactical stylus; physically tests impossible structures rather than accepting official explanations.

EFW_Rae.name: Rae
EFW_Rae.notes: Source-locked traits: detects catastrophic patterns in suppressed telemetry; protects erased coordinates and evidence from institutional scrutiny; grounds herself by tracing geometric grids against her thigh or nearby surfaces.

EFW_Adrian.name: Adrian
EFW_Adrian.role: Envoy / antiquarian with knowledge of the forgotten war
EFW_Adrian.notes: Source-locked traits: controlled, methodical and containment-minded; recognizes awakening signatures in Theo and ancient machinery; carries the burden of prior erasure and repeatedly minimizes or contains evidence even when physically undeniable.

EFW_Caelum.name: Caelum
EFW_Caelum.notes: Institutional authority who challenges Rae's telemetry handling and attempts to preserve administrative control as anomalies breach ordinary procedure.

EFW_Vark.name: Vark
EFW_Vark.notes: Practical industrial supervisor. He witnesses Theo uncover and activate the buried monolith and becomes an immediate counterweight to Theo's dangerous certainty.

EFW_Vael.name: Vael
EFW_Vael.role: War-era operator / participant appearing in the supplied teleplays
EFW_Vael.notes: Source record retained from the development scripts. Detailed role should be read from the relevant episode scene before adaptation rather than inferred beyond the teleplay.
